description: A flexible, production-ready Clean Architecture template for .NET with optional Aspire orchestration, CQRS, DDD, multiple database providers (PostgreSQL, SQL Server, SQLite), optional JWT Authentication, front-end options (React, Angular, Blazor), Health Checks, OpenTelemetry, and comprehensive testing. Configure your ideal setup via the wizard.
releaseNotes:
Version 1.1.0:
- Flexible wizard: optional Aspire orchestration (API-only mode)
- Optional JWT Authentication (exclude auth and Users feature)
- Front-end scaffolds: React (Vite), Angular, Blazor WebAssembly
- Features section in appsettings (IncludeAuthentication, ApplyMigrationsOnStartup, IncludeSeedData)
- Conditional migrations based on config
- Conditional Swagger (with/without auth)
- API style choice: Minimal APIs or Controllers
- Logging stack: Default or Serilog
- Deployment profiles: LocalOnly, Docker, Azure
- Database providers: PostgreSQL, SQL Server, SQLite
- Example features toggle (Todos/Users)
- Docker and Docker Compose toggles

Version 1.0.9:
- Removed PortFinder utility and all remaining code related to automatic port allocation
- Cleaned up solution structure for tests (CleanArchitectureTests) and confirmed successful build/test

Version 1.0.8:
- Removed automatic dynamic port allocation and pinned Web.Api ports to 5000 (HTTP) and 5001 (HTTPS)
- Ensured Web.Api Docker image exposes ports 5000 and 5001
- Renamed architecture tests project to follow solution name (e.g., SampleTests) via CleanArchitectureTests template naming
- Updated README troubleshooting section with guidance for Aspire port conflicts and default ports (5000, 5001, 15000)

Version 1.0.7:
- Migrated Swashbuckle.AspNetCore to v10 (Microsoft.OpenApi.Models → Microsoft.OpenApi)
- Updated security requirement configuration for OpenAPI 3.1 compatibility
- Fixed HTTPS profile to show only HTTPS endpoint (removed duplicate HTTP URL)

Version 1.0.6:
- Fixed Aspire HTTPS requirement error (ASPIRE_ALLOW_UNSECURED_TRANSPORT)
- Added ASPIRE_ALLOW_UNSECURED_TRANSPORT=true to all Aspire launch profiles
- Updated Aspire launch profile to use HTTPS profile explicitly
- Resolves OptionsValidationException for unsecured transport
- Improved port binding configuration (changed to non-reserved ports 52017/50183)

Version 1.0.5:
- Fixed Aspire HTTPS requirement error (ASPIRE_ALLOW_UNSECURED_TRANSPORT)
- Added ASPIRE_ALLOW_UNSECURED_TRANSPORT=true to all Aspire launch profiles
- Updated Aspire launch profile to use HTTPS profile explicitly
- Resolves OptionsValidationException for unsecured transport
- Improved port binding configuration

Version 1.0.4:
- Fixed Aspire endpoint naming conflict (duplicate 'http' endpoint error)
- Changed endpoint names to 'http-api' and 'https-api' for uniqueness
- Resolves DistributedApplicationException when launching Aspire profile

Version 1.0.3:
- Added Aspire launch profile to Web.Api for easy orchestration
- Fixed database connection errors when running standalone
- Improved migration handling with graceful error handling
- Configured explicit ports (5000/5001) to prevent port conflicts
- Migration extension now skips migrations if connection string is not configured
- Enhanced error logging for database operations

Version 1.0.2:
- Removed Contributing section from README
- Removed release notes

Version 1.0.1:
- Fixed Entity Framework Core version conflicts (MSB3277)
- Restored Visual Studio launch settings
- Excluded editor configs (.editorconfig, .cursorrules) from template
title: Clean Architecture Template with Aspire
